findings.title: Refund→commission reversal leaves split status unchanged and reversals invisible to liability
findings.fixHint: When reversal hits 100% of split.calculatedAmount → flip status to 'void' or new 'reversed'; subtract reversal sums from liabilityByStaff / liabilitySummary

findings.title: upsertCategoryCommissionConfig DELETE+INSERT reactivates deactivated configs
findings.fixHint: Preserve prior isActive; or convert to update-on-existing + insert-when-absent

findings.title: getCategoryCommissionConfig has no isActive filter — returns inactive rows the calculator skips
findings.fixHint: Add and(eq(categoryId, ...), eq(isActive, true)) or expose includeInactive flag

findings.title: getMyCommissions filters createdAt instead of earnedAt (inconsistent with every other read)
liabilitySummary uses lte(earnedAt,to) causing boundary double-counting
findings.fixHint: Switch to lt for exclusive upper bound consistent with applyCommissionCaps

findings.title: POS conditional path returns [] with no warn/audit when no condition matches minQuantity
findings.fixHint: Mirror appointment path: console.warn + writeAudit({action:'commission.skip', reason})

findings.title: payouts.list excludes reversal/clawback rows for non-admins (appointmentId-join filter)

findings.title: categoryCommission.upsert hard-codes 'create' permission — users with update only are blocked
recipientSummary.avgPerCycle collapses same-day cycles + includes negative reversals
findings.fixHint: Group by batchId when available; ignore negative-amount rows (reversal adjustments) for avg

findings.title: Per-cycle commission cap uses UTC calendar month — mis-aligned with custom payout windows
findings.deferReason: Requires payout-window config model + migration; cross-cutting change. Log as S-cycle-window-alignment.

findings.title: payout_batches never populated by runBatch — table/columns orphan

findings.title: Stripe webhook handler missing for payout.*/transfer.* events — payout lifecycle pending→paid unreachable

findings.title: partner_stripe_accounts table entirely orphan — no procedure onboards, reads, or writes it
